description:
Free, browser-based tool to open almost any sequence file — FASTA, FASTQ, GenBank, EMBL, Swiss-Prot, AB1/ABIF, Clustal, Stockholm, PHYLIP, NEXUS, MSF, PIR and more — see every sequence inside, pick the ones you want, and save them as FASTA. 

Runs entirely in your browser — your data never leaves your machine.
name: picklet
